Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one square approximately 1024-class tissue appearance map for UV mapping an anatomical 3D model; AI-generated illustration, not a patient photograph or calibrated PBR capture.
Composition: continuous fully opaque material covering EVERY pixel, including all corners and edges. Perfectly face-on, flat macro surface, consistent focus. No specimen silhouette, organ outline, circular swatch, cutout, transparent pixels, border, vignette, fade, backdrop or perspective shading.
Lighting: extremely uniform neutral diffuse illumination and restrained contrast. No hard specular highlight, shiny white hotspot, cast shadow, directional light gradient, metallic reflection or dramatic lighting. Preserve fine biological texture without baked large-scale relief.
Subject: healthy-looking lung OUTER visceral pleural surface, natural restrained soft pink. A continuous smooth delicate pleural film over very subtle small pulmonary lobular colour divisions, with only a very few faint hairline superficial vessels. The lobulation is gentle tonal variation under an intact surface, not an open cellular pattern.
Avoid: open alveoli, alveolar cross-section, honeycomb, foam, sponge, air holes, disease, soot, large vessels, lung outline or lobar fissures.
Constraints: exactly one square image, one continuous tissue surface, no words, text, labels, symbols, watermark, instruments, containers, hands, fluids, blood drops or separate objects. No organ anatomy drawn into the texture. No deep cracks, large pores or ornamental repeating pattern.

referenceUse: University teaching/primary microscopy resources were consulted for tissue-layer semantics only. No reference image pixels were downloaded, copied into these maps or supplied to the generator. User-requested palette and macro appearance remain illustrative.
integrationNotes: Assign by exact organ or vessel material identity, never map all generic organ slots to one image.
Use sRGB base colour with a neutral multiplier; retain original PNG metadata and per-image attribution.
Lung is outer visceral pleura, not an exposed alveolar or diseased honeycomb cut surface.
Myocardium key is an illustrative external epicardial/myocardial appearance, not a full model of epicardial fat or coronary vessels and not endocardium.
Pancreas is superficial glandular lobulation, spleen is intact capsule, gastric_serosa is outer stomach serosa rather than mucosal rugae.
vessel_wall is generic external adventitial connective-tissue appearance; not lumen blood, not intima, and not a measured distinction between named artery/vein histological types.
These maps do not add anatomical shape, microscopic geometry, vascular connections, optical translucency or mechanics. Root handles 3D material and GLB integration review.
